entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. Your online return portal is garbage and I've been waiting on hold for ten minutes. This is completely unacceptable.

I certainly apologize for the wait and any trouble with the website. I can definitely help you with a return. To get started, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It doesn't matter what the issue is! I don't want it anymore. It's uncomfortable and the battery life is a joke. I just want my money back. Now.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your account information to get the process started. Can I have your name and order number?
The name is Mark Peterson. I don't have the order number, just find it. You should be able to do that, right?
Of course. One moment, Mark... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th.
Great. So process the refund. I'm not going to spend my whole day on this.
Okay, I just need to quickly verify the return eligibility against our current policy.

What is there to verify? A policy? Don't you dare tell me it's too late. If you give me any trouble with this, I swear I will post a review on every single website I can find and I'll be contacting the Better Business Bureau. Get me your manager, right now!

Sir, there's no need for that, I'm sure we can resolve this. Let me just check the official documentation... Okay. I'm looking at our knowledge base right now, and it states our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery for a full refund.
Since you received it 33 days ago, you're well within that timeframe. I can approve this return for you immediately. I'm generating a prepaid return label to send to your email on file.
Oh. Well... fine. That's what you should have done from the start. Make sure that email gets to me.

I've just sent it now. You should see it within the next 5 minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued. Was there anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
